import random,time,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import ebpf.create_dfa as C
from syntax import parse_policy

def moore(n,m,trans,acc):
    if n<=1:return [0]*n
    block=[1 if x else 0 for x in acc]
    # normalize maybe
    num=len(set(block))
    rounds=0
    while True:
        rounds+=1
        mp={}; new=[0]*n
        for s in range(n):
            row=trans[s]
            key=(block[s],)+tuple(block[t] for t in row)
            v=mp.get(key)
            if v is None:
                v=len(mp);mp[key]=v
            new[s]=v
        if len(mp)==num:
            # Because we included block[s], no old block split. Since number
            # of blocks unchanged, partition is stable.
            block=new
            print('moore rounds',rounds,'n',n,file=sys.stderr)
            return block
        block=new;num=len(mp)
        if rounds%10==0:print('round',rounds,'blocks',num,file=sys.stderr)
C._hopcroft=moore
random.seed(44)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
S=set()
while len(S)<4096:S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(16)))
paths=[','.join(names[i] for i in t) for t in S]
text=''.join('match('+p+') allow;' for p in paths)
p=parse_policy(text)
t=time.time()
try:
 im=C.create(text,reg,p);print('compile',time.time()-t,'rows',len(im['rows']))
except Exception as e:print('reject',type(e).__name__,e,'time',time.time()-t)
